content: औत्सर्गिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [उत्सर्ग-ष्ठञ्] .²1 That which is liable to be abolished in exceptional cases, though generally valid (as a rule of grammar). .²2 General (<ab>opp.</ab> to particular), not restricted .²3 Terminating, concluding. .²4 Leaving, quitting. .²5 Natural, inherent. .²6 Produced naturally or directly. .²7 Derivative.
